learn.rule: A joining word tells how two ideas connect: time (when, after, before, until), reason (because), contrast (although), or condition (if, unless).
learn.ruleEs: Una palabra de unión dice cómo se conectan dos ideas: tiempo (when, after, before, until), razón (because), contraste (although) o condición (if, unless).
learn.model: Water vapor turns into clouds when it rises and cools in the air.
learn.notice: When tells the time: the clouds form at the moment the vapor rises and cools.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that shows time in this puddle sentence.
parts: the sun shines on them for several hours.
items.model: Puddles dry up after the sun shines on them for several hours.
items.why: After tells the order in time: first the sun shines, then the puddle dries.
items.whyEs: After dice el orden en el tiempo: primero brilla el sol y después se seca el charco.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that gives the reason in this plant sentence.
parts: their roots cannot find enough water.
items.model: Plants wilt because their roots cannot find enough water.
items.why: Because introduces the reason the plants wilt.
items.whyEs: Because presenta la razón por la que las plantas se marchitan.

items.prompt: What does although tell the reader in this frozen pond sentence?
items.text: Although the pond froze, the fish stayed alive underneath.

options.text: a reason
a time
a surprise or contrast

items.why: Although shows a contrast. We might expect the fish to die, but they stayed alive.
items.whyEs: Although muestra un contraste. Podríamos esperar que los peces murieran, pero siguieron vivos.

items.prompt: Choose a joining word for each blank in this storm advice.
parts: the clouds look dark. Stay inside
items.model: Bring an umbrella if the clouds look dark. Stay inside until the thunder stops.
items.why: If sets a condition for the umbrella. Until tells how long to stay inside.
items.whyEs: If pone una condición para el paraguas. Until dice hasta cuándo quedarse adentro.

items.prompt: Check every sentence where the joining word shows a reason.

options.text: Rivers flow downhill until they reach a lake or the sea.
Ice floats because it is less dense than liquid water.
We saw a rainbow after the rain stopped.
Leaves look green because they contain chlorophyll.
Although the desert is dry, some plants grow there.

items.why: Because gives a reason. Until and after show time, and although shows a contrast.
items.whyEs: Because da una razón. Until y after muestran tiempo, y although muestra un contraste.

items.prompt: Which joining word fits best in this ice sentence?
items.text: The ice will melt ____ you leave it in the sun.

options.text: unless
although
if

items.why: If sets the condition that makes the ice melt. Unless and although change the meaning.
items.whyEs: If pone la condición que derrite el hielo. Unless y although cambian el significado.

write.prompt: Write one sentence about weather or water. Use a joining word such as when, after, because, although, if, or until.
write.promptEs: Escribe una oración sobre el clima o el agua. Usa una palabra de unión como when, after, because, although, if o until.

label: I used a joining word (when, because, if...)
Usé una palabra de unión (when, because, if...)

write.model: We bring umbrellas when the sky fills with dark clouds.

familyTalk.en: Finish together: 'We stay inside if ...' and 'We go outside after ...'.
familyTalk.es: Terminen juntos: 'Nos quedamos adentro if ...' y 'Salimos after ...'.

teacherTip.en: Sort joining words on the board into four columns: time, reason, contrast, condition.
teacherTip.es: Clasifica las palabras de unión en la pizarra en cuatro columnas: tiempo, razón, contraste, condición.

learn.rule: A joining word tells how two ideas connect: time (when, after, before, until), reason (because), contrast (although), or condition (if, unless).
learn.ruleEs: Una palabra de unión dice cómo se conectan dos ideas: tiempo (when, after, before, until), razón (because), contraste (although) o condición (if, unless).
learn.model: The pioneers rested before they crossed the wide river.
learn.notice: Before tells the order in time: first they rested, then they crossed.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that tells how long the pioneers walked.
parts: The pioneers walked beside their wagons
items.model: The pioneers walked beside their wagons until they reached the next fort.
items.why: Until tells the time when the walking stopped: at the next fort.
items.whyEs: Until dice el momento en que terminó la caminata: en el siguiente fuerte.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that gives the reason for packing extra food.
parts: Families packed extra flour and beans
food was hard to find on the trail.
items.model: Families packed extra flour and beans because food was hard to find on the trail.
items.why: Because tells the reason families packed extra food.
items.whyEs: Because dice la razón por la que las familias empacaron más comida.

items.prompt: What does unless tell the reader in this river crossing sentence?
items.text: The wagons could not cross the river unless the water was low.

options.text: a time
a condition that must be met
a reason

items.why: Unless names a condition. The wagons could cross only if the water was low.
items.whyEs: Unless nombra una condición. Las carretas solo podían cruzar si el agua estaba baja.

items.prompt: Choose a joining word for each blank in this cabin story.
parts: the cabin had a thick roof.
items.model: Settlers built a cabin before winter arrived. They stayed warm because the cabin had a thick roof.
items.why: Before shows the cabin was built first. Because gives the reason they stayed warm.
items.whyEs: Before muestra que la cabaña se construyó primero. Because da la razón por la que estaban abrigados.

items.prompt: Check every sentence where the joining word shows contrast.

options.text: The pioneers camped near a creek after they walked all day.
Although the trail was dangerous, thousands of families traveled west.
Many pioneers kept diaries because they wanted to remember the trip.
Although the oxen were slow, they could pull heavy wagons.

items.why: Although shows a contrast or surprise. After shows time, and because shows a reason.
items.whyEs: Although muestra un contraste o una sorpresa. After muestra tiempo y because muestra una razón.

items.prompt: Which joining word fits best in this waiting sentence?
items.text: The pioneers waited ____ the river fell low enough to cross.

options.text: because
although
until

items.why: Until tells how long they waited: up to the moment the river fell.
items.whyEs: Until dice cuánto esperaron: hasta el momento en que bajó el río.

write.prompt: Write one sentence about a trip or a journey. Use before, after, until, or because.
write.promptEs: Escribe una oración sobre un viaje. Usa before, after, until o because.

label: I used a joining word (before, after, until, because)
Usé una palabra de unión (before, after, until, because)

write.model: We packed snacks before we left for the long drive to my grandparents' house.

familyTalk.en: Tell about a trip using 'before we left ...' and 'after we arrived ...'.
familyTalk.es: Cuenten un viaje usando 'before we left ...' y 'after we arrived ...'.

teacherTip.en: Mime a sequence of actions and ask students to describe it with before and after in one sentence.
teacherTip.es: Representa una secuencia de acciones y pide que los estudiantes la describan con before y after en una sola oración.

learn.rule: A joining word tells how two ideas connect: time (when, after, before, until), reason (because), contrast (although), or condition (if, unless).
learn.ruleEs: Una palabra de unión dice cómo se conectan dos ideas: tiempo (when, after, before, until), razón (because), contraste (although) o condición (if, unless).
learn.model: A number is even if you can split it into two equal groups.
learn.notice: If sets the condition: the number is even only when it can be split into two equal groups.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that gives a condition in this equation sentence.
parts: both sides of the equation are equal.
items.model: The answer is correct if both sides of the equation are equal.
items.why: If sets the condition for the answer to be correct.
items.whyEs: If pone la condición para que la respuesta sea correcta.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that shows time in this order-of-operations sentence.
parts: Add the numbers inside the parentheses
items.model: Add the numbers inside the parentheses before you multiply.
items.why: Before tells the order in time: first add inside the parentheses, then multiply.
items.whyEs: Before dice el orden en el tiempo: primero se suma dentro de los paréntesis y luego se multiplica.

items.prompt: What does while tell the reader in this coin sentence?
items.text: Sam counted the coins while Ana wrote the total.

options.text: one thing is a reason
two things happen at the same time
one thing is a surprise

items.why: While shows that two actions happen at the same time.
items.whyEs: While muestra que dos acciones suceden al mismo tiempo.

items.prompt: Choose a joining word for each blank in these fraction rules.
parts: you multiply the top and bottom by the same number. Keep dividing both numbers
items.model: A fraction keeps its value if you multiply the top and bottom by the same number. Keep dividing both numbers until the fraction cannot be simplified.
items.why: If sets a condition for keeping the value. Until tells when to stop dividing.
items.whyEs: If pone una condición para conservar el valor. Until dice cuándo dejar de dividir.

items.prompt: Check every math sentence where the joining word shows a reason.

options.text: Round the number up if the next digit is five or more.
Ten is a multiple of five because five times two equals ten.
Although seven is odd, it is also a prime number.
Twelve is divisible by four because four times three equals twelve.
Check your work after you finish the problem.

items.why: Because gives the reason a math fact is true. If shows a condition, although shows contrast, and after shows time.
items.whyEs: Because da la razón por la que un hecho matemático es verdadero. If muestra condición, although contraste y after tiempo.

items.prompt: Which joining word fits best in this area sentence?
items.text: We cannot find the area ____ we know both the length and the width.

options.text: although
because
until

items.why: Until shows we must wait for the missing information: the length and width.
items.whyEs: Until muestra que debemos esperar la información que falta: el largo y el ancho.

write.prompt: Write one sentence about a math rule or a math job. Use if, before, after, because, or until.
write.promptEs: Escribe una oración sobre una regla de matemáticas o una tarea de matemáticas. Usa if, before, after, because o until.

label: I used a joining word (if, before, after, because, until)
Usé una palabra de unión (if, before, after, because, until)

write.model: Always check your answer after you finish the last problem on the page.

familyTalk.en: Say a rule at home: 'We can go outside if ...' or 'We clean up before ...'.
familyTalk.es: Digan una regla en casa: 'We can go outside if ...' o 'We clean up before ...'.

teacherTip.en: Ask students to rewrite one rule from today's math lesson, starting with a joining word.
teacherTip.es: Pide que los estudiantes reescriban una regla de la lección de matemáticas de hoy, empezando con una palabra de unión.
